messages:
maya: Hey team — quick design review request for the Prompt Sets > Eval Runs view. I pushed a prototype that changes the regression-diff list density and moves the bulk-approve affordance into the top toolbar instead of the floating CTA. Looking for accessibility + microcopy nits before I hand to eng. https://figma.com/file/xyz
sam: Saw it — nice 🙌. First impression: the denser list looks good for power users but I worry about scannability for new folks.
jorge: Agreed. Can we keep 2 line per row min? right now some items collapse to 1 line and it's hard to parse status badges.
maya: Good call. Proposal: compact mode (single-line) + roomy mode (2-line) toggle in the toolbar. Defaults to roomy for new orgs, remember last choice per user. Thoughts?
rita: Toggle sounds reasonable. Make sure the focus order doesn't skip the toggle (keyboard users). Also need clear labels: "Compact" / "Comfortable" maybe?
sam: Microcopy: bulk approve CTA — prefer "Approve selected runs" over "Bulk approve". clearer what action does.
maya: OK — will update copy. UX-bot: accessibility check — We Need aria-live updates for the inline approval count so screen readers announce selections. Also keyboard shortcut for select-all?
ux-bot: recommendation: announce "3 runs selected" using polite aria-live region; shortcut: shift+A is already used elsewhere; suggest "a" when focus in list or use "/" for quick-select.
jorge: Another nit: regression diff collapse/expand affordance — currently chevrons are small hit targets. Increase to 40px and add explicit label "Show diffs" for screen readers.
sam: Also add visible focus ring to the approve button. Current outline is too faint on high-contrast themes. CSS snippet for stronger focus: 
```css
button:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 120, 215, 0.35); outline: none; }
```
maya: thanks — will push that. One more: confirmation modal copy for bulk approve. Current: "Are you sure?" — too vague. Proposed: "Approve X runs — this will mark selected eval results as approved and lock their scorecards." Add undo toast with 10s window.
rita: +1 for explicit consequences. UX needs language about who can unapprove (roles).
jorge: UX question: where does the undo go? toast should include link "Undo" and a small ellipsis menu to view the list of changed runs.
maya: plan: toast text "Approved 5 runs. [Undo] [View changes]" and action in the toolbar to open change history.
sam: tiny visual suggestion: add a subtle divider between run rows when in roomy mode to help scanning. In compact mode remove divider and increase hover highlight instead.
maya: sounds good. I'll update the prototype with: default roomy, per-user toggle, accessible labels, stronger focus styles, improved modal copy, undo toast, and change-history link.
rita: one last thing: keyboard-only flow test before handing to eng — I'll run through and post a short doc with steps.
maya: awesome — thanks all. Will iterate and post updated link by EOD. :thumbsup:
